title: Garlicky Buckwheat Toast
description: A simple yet flavorful breakfast dish made with buckwheat, garlic, and lightly toasted bread.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the buckwheat groats and cook, stirring frequently, for 5-7 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Meanwhile, toast the bread slices until lightly browned.
To assemble the dish, divide the buckwheat groats among the toast slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt to taste.
